settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.intro: Everything you need to know about ordering, shipping, returns, and caring for your jewellery.
settings.closing_text: Still have a question? We’d love to help.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — we offer free standard shipping on all UK orders over £50. Orders under £50 ship for a flat rate of [CONFIRM: £3.50].

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer:
UK standard delivery takes 3–5 working days. Orders placed before [CONFIRM: 2pm] on a working day are dispatched the same day.

We’ll send you a tracking link by email as soon as your order is on its way.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer:
[CONFIRM: Yes, we ship to Europe and select international destinations. European delivery typically takes 5–7 working days, and international orders 7–14 working days. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout.]

[CONFIRM: Please note that international orders may be subject to local customs duties or import taxes, which are the responsibility of the recipient.]

settings.question: Will I receive tracking information?
settings.answer: Yes. Once your order has been dispatched, you’ll receive an email with a tracking link so you can follow your parcel’s journey.

settings.question: What happens if my order is delayed?
settings.answer: Occasionally, deliveries can take a little longer than expected — particularly during busy periods. If your order hasn’t arrived within the estimated timeframe, please get in touch at hello@daphneblue.co.uk and we’ll look into it straight away.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: We want you to be completely happy with your purchase. If something isn’t quite right, you can return it within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unworn, undamaged, and in their original packaging.

settings.question: How do I return an item?
settings.answer:
To start a return, email us at hello@daphneblue.co.uk with your order number and the item you’d like to return. We’ll send you instructions and a return address.

[CONFIRM: Please post your return using a tracked service — we can’t be held responsible for items lost in transit.]

settings.question: Who pays for return shipping?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Return shipping costs are covered by the customer, unless the item arrived damaged or faulty — in which case we’ll cover the return postage in full.]

settings.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or style?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: We don’t currently offer direct exchanges. If you’d like a different size or style, simply return your original item for a refund and place a new order. This ensures you get exactly what you’re looking for without any delay.]

settings.question: How long will my refund take?
settings.answer: Once we’ve received your return and confirmed everything is in order, we’ll process your refund within [CONFIRM: 3–5] working days. It may take a little longer for the funds to appear in your account depending on your bank.

settings.question: What if my item arrives damaged?
settings.answer: We’re sorry if anything arrives less than perfect. Please email us at hello@daphneblue.co.uk with a photo of the damage and your order number, and we’ll arrange a replacement or full refund as quickly as possible.

settings.question: How do I find my ring size?
settings.answer:
The easiest way is to measure a ring you already wear. Place it on a ruler and measure the internal diameter in millimetres, then compare it to a standard ring size chart.

[CONFIRM: If you’re unsure, we’re happy to help — just drop us a message and we can guide you through it. We also offer a printable ring sizer that you can request by emailing hello@daphneblue.co.uk.]

settings.question: What necklace length should I choose?
settings.answer:
Our necklaces come in a range of lengths. As a general guide:

40cm (16″) sits close to the collarbone. 45cm (18″) falls just below it — our most popular length. 50cm (20″) sits a little lower, perfect for layering.

Most of our chains include a 5cm extension so you can adjust the fit to suit you.

settings.question: Are bracelets adjustable?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Many of our bracelets include an extension chain for a flexible fit. Check the individual product page for specific measurements and details.]

settings.question: What materials do you use?
settings.answer: Our pieces are crafted from [CONFIRM: sterling silver (925) and 18k gold vermeil — a thick layer of 18-karat gold over a sterling silver base]. We choose materials that feel beautiful on skin and are made to be worn every day.

settings.question: What is gold vermeil?
settings.answer: Vermeil (pronounced ‘ver-may’) is a thick layer of gold — at least 2.5 microns — bonded to a sterling silver base. It’s far more durable than standard gold plating and gives you the warmth of gold with the strength of silver underneath.

settings.question: Will my jewellery tarnish?
settings.answer: All fine metals can develop a natural patina over time, particularly sterling silver. With a little care, your pieces will stay looking their best for years. We recommend storing them in a dry place and giving them a gentle polish with a soft cloth from time to time.

settings.question: Is your jewellery hypoallergenic?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Our sterling silver and gold vermeil pieces are nickel-free and suitable for most sensitive skin. If you have specific allergies, please get in touch and we’ll be happy to advise.]

settings.question: How should I care for my jewellery?
settings.answer:
A few small habits make a real difference. Store your pieces in a dry place away from direct sunlight. Put your jewellery on last — after perfume, moisturiser, and hairspray. Clean gently with a soft, lint-free cloth.

For sterling silver, a silver polishing cloth will bring back its original brightness. For gold vermeil, avoid abrasive cleaners — a soft cloth and warm water is all you need.

settings.question: Can I shower or swim wearing my jewellery?
settings.answer: We’d recommend removing your jewellery before showering, swimming, or exercising. Prolonged contact with water, chlorine, and sweat can accelerate wear on any fine metal — especially gold vermeil. Treating your pieces gently will help them last beautifully.

settings.question: Do you offer repairs or replating?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: We don’t currently offer a repair or replating service, but we’re always happy to help if something isn’t right. Get in touch and we’ll see what we can do.]

settings.question: What packaging do orders arrive in?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Every order arrives in our signature Daphne Blue packaging — a soft pouch nestled inside a branded box, ready to give or to keep. We believe the experience of receiving jewellery should feel special, even when it’s a gift to yourself.]

settings.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Our standard packaging is designed to feel gift-ready, so no additional wrapping is needed. If you’d like us to include a handwritten note, just add a message at checkout and we’ll tuck it in.]

settings.question: Can I include a gift message?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Yes — you can add a personal message during checkout and we’ll include it with your order on a hand-finished card. No prices or invoices are included with gift orders.]

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. All payments are processed securely through Shopify’s encrypted checkout.]

settings.question: Can I cancel or amend my order after placing it?
settings.answer: We aim to dispatch orders quickly, so please get in touch as soon as possible if you need to make a change. Email us at hello@daphneblue.co.uk and we’ll do our best to help — but once an order has been dispatched, we won’t be able to amend it.

settings.question: Do you offer Klarna or Clearpay?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Not at the moment, but it’s something we’re considering for the future. For now, we accept all major cards and digital wallets at checkout.]

settings.question: Who is behind Daphne Blue?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Daphne Blue was founded by [NAME] with a simple idea: jewellery should feel as natural as getting dressed. Every piece is chosen — or designed — to be lived in, not saved for special occasions. We’re a small, independent brand based in the UK.]

settings.question: Where are your pieces made?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Our pieces are handcrafted by skilled artisans in small batches. We work with trusted workshops that share our commitment to quality and care. Every piece is finished by hand and checked before it reaches you.]

settings.question: What does “chosen with care” mean?
settings.answer: It’s at the heart of everything we do. Every piece in our collection is thoughtfully selected — for how it feels on skin, how it catches the light, how it fits into your day. We don’t chase trends or fill our shop for the sake of it. If it doesn’t feel right, it doesn’t make the cut.
